nina: quick check-in 14 — we need a reusable, minimal migration template for model catalog swaps that captures opt-in windows, enterprise exemptions, and a clear set of automated gates. want something PMs can run without heavy SRE lift. thoughts?
omar: +1. customers repeatedly ask for explicit "stay-on-old" contracts per route. can we formalize an "exemption list" that sales/legal can attach?
kevin: propose 4 automated gates: infra-compat, perf (p95/throughput), semantic-regressions, and safety (hallucination/TOX). each gate reports PASS/WARN/FAIL. default: WARN blocks auto-swap, PASS allows. Fail stops opt-in. numeric thresholds example: p95 +10ms, throughput -5%, semantic regression <1.5% on core suite.
tara: operationally, add two paths: 1) "clean swap" (all gates PASS) -> schedule swap + 7-day reversible pin, 2) "conditioned rollout" (WARN present) -> opt-in only, extra monitoring, no default routing. add canary cadence: internal smoke (24h), invited customers (7d), default swap (if green).
yoan: for enterprise contracts: add fields: exemption_routes (list), auto_upgrade (bool), early_access (bool), migration_notice_days (int). Legal wants default notice=14 days. Sales wants an SLA clause for regressions (credit or rollback). I'll draft template.
kevin: monitoring: wire three continuous signals into catalog UI: semantic_delta, latency_delta, error_rate. add a single risk_score = weighted(sum(normalized signals)). show risk_score badge next to model entry. set an auto-block threshold.
deploy-bot: preflight-check started: `catalog-preflight --new catalog/eta-lite-v1 --old eta-lite-v0 --suite baseline`. ETA 12m.
nina: UX ask: Console should show per-model migration timeline, current state (invited, opt-in, default-off, swapped), and a one-click "revert pin" for 7 days. also show estimated cost delta and a short risk blurb.
omar: bench plan: microbench (64/256/1024 sequences, batch sizes [1,8,32]), semantic regressions (core suite + 3 enterprise-supplied prompts). require n>=150 per prompt. archive outputs and diffs.
tara: ops-runbook: create `migration-run` checklist with commands: `catalog-preflight`, `rw-canary --mode focused|broad`, `monitor-watch --model X --window 24h`. escalate path: if auto-rollback triggers, page #eng-oncall and product owner. define auto-rollback triggers: >3% semantic regression sustained for 30m, p95 increase >50ms for 60m, or user error rate >2x baseline.
kevin: edge-case: quantized vs fp variants. policy: if quantized variant fails semantic gate by >2% then route traffic to fp variant until fixed. document fallback in routing layer.
yoan: I'll share enterprise migration contract draft by EOD. tara: I'll add the runbook and ops checks to repo and wire deploy-bot hooks (72h). kevin: I'll compute risk_score defaults and dashboard panels (48h). omar: I'll prepare Console UX copy + early-access toggle (48h). nina: PM will publish the template playbook and a single-page migration checklist once those land.
deploy-bot: preflight finished: result=partial-pass, semantic warnings in long-context prompts. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/2141709999
kevin: long-context warnings again. block default swap, allow invited cohorts and enterprise opt-ins with a bold risk banner. add targeted long-context regression tests (2048/4096 token lengths).
nyan: noted (typo?), will kick off focused long-context runs and link results.
11: reconvene after triage. nina: thanks everyone, this looks actionable.
